steps.name: python:3.11-slim
args:
set -euo pipefail
pip install -q -r scripts/orion_ews/requirements.txt google-cloud-bigquery google-cloud-storage
python -m scripts.orion_ews.ingest doctor --ping --no-from-secret
python -m scripts.orion_ews.ingest readings --precip-only --days 1   --out /workspace/orion_readings.ndjson   --bq-project $PROJECT_ID --bq-dataset efc_clima   --gcs-prefix gs://efc-clima-data/obs/ews/ --no-from-secret
